authorized_by: User submitted SENTRY_Path2_BERT_AIE_Execution_Prompt.md on 2026-10-15; approved Git synchronization separately
decision_stage: whole-model offline feasibility and isolated co-design comparison

teacher.selection: Existing development-selected matched BERT; seed42 fixed independently of exposed confirmation

selection_rule: Keep original model and conventional reference. Qualify exact integer/casts; report numerical and decision changes. Select target-native BF16 attention only if correct functional implementation and development behavior are established; no held-out-based rescue.

calibration_policy.criterion_status: reporting points, not safety guarantees or adoption gates

hypothesis: At identical whole-BERT numerics, retain encoder intermediates in the connected compute path rather than writing each intermediate to external memory; compare complete schedule and measured traffic/latency, including residency storage and the actual PL/AIE crossings.
controls: same model/numerics with conventional intermediate spills
same model/numerics with resident intermediate buffers
FP32 reference versus frozen W8/A8 with FP32 and BF16 attention
falsifier: Residency is not useful within tested scope if it cannot fit/connect or if complete measured latency/traffic does not improve after storage, crossings and clock differences are included. Absence of a novel distinction from CAT/SSR means supporting engineering only.

constraints.training: No initial training; reuse fixed model. Any later justified adaptation recipe must be recorded before fit and confirmation.

bounded_matrix.correction_policy: At most two focused corrections per diagnosed integration blocker, retain each failure
bounded_matrix.reserve: At least half GPU budget reserved for confirmation and full model differential/profile evidence

evidence_boundary: Detector labels and software differential checks do not prove downstream protection, synthesized timing, routed closure, board latency or energy. Porting established techniques alone is not scientific novelty.
preserved_unused_panel: results/dual_track_v1/shared/prospective_v1; no quality evaluation; initial alternative timing superseded by shared/data/timing_manifest.json
configuration_policy: Scientific configuration freezes here; subsequent actual execution states and cumulative resources are recorded in task report and result ledgers.
